cards.title: Managing Type 1 Diabetes as a Parent
cards.body: England rugby player Henry Slade reflects on his type 1 diabetes diagnosis and how his father's experience with the condition helped him cope. His parents made significant sacrifices to support his health alongside his sporting career.

cards.title: Adult Child Returns Home After Graduation
cards.body: A mother navigates the challenges of having her graduate son back home in a difficult economy. She reflects on how her parenting approach has shifted after five months of readjustment.

cards.title: Balancing Adventure and Parental Responsibility
cards.body: A columnist questions whether it's acceptable for parents to leave their families, including small children, to pursue wilderness adventures or world travel. She examines the trade-offs between personal fulfillment and parental duty.

cards.title: Modernizing Nursery Rhymes for Today's Kids
cards.body: Educator Pam Gittleman is updating traditional nursery rhymes with contemporary lyrics to better resonate with modern children. This approach promotes social, emotional, and cognitive development benefits for young learners.

cards.title: School Anxiety Harming Children's Futures
cards.body: A BBC investigation reveals how severe school anxiety is affecting young people's attendance and educational outcomes. School avoiders and educators discuss solutions to address this growing mental health challenge.
